title: Testing and validation of a German disease specific quality of live questionnaire for women with gestational diabetes mellitus
summary: Including aspects of quality of life in the evaluation of new diagnostic and therapeutic interventions is necessary for the optimization of patients' adherence. Despite the importance of gestational diabetes, there is still no scientifically based instrument for recording the disease-specific quality of life for this disease. Within the study, a psychometric questionnaire is to be prospectively tested and validated, which depicts disease-specific aspects of the quality of life of women with gestational diabetes.

interventions.name: Answering a newly developed 69-item QoL questionnaire on gestational diabetes by pregnant women with gestational diabetes. Comparison of the results with validated QoL-questionnaires (WHO-Bref, VR-12, EQ-5D-5L und PAID-20). The questionnaires are collected during the third trimester of pregnancy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus
Exclusion criteria:
Pre-existing diabetes mellitus, multiple gestation, hypertensive pregnancy disorders, threatened preterm birth requiring inpatient treatment, pre-existing mental illness (e.g. depression, anxiety or bipolar disorders), cognitive limitations and a linguistic or other type of inability to answer questions
